Per instruction Section 2 ('Toolchain/dependency kurmak gerekiyorsa otomatik sistem mutation yapma; SKIPPED olarak raporla'), brew/cargo system mutation was avoided without sudo.

thermalArchitecture.codeSnippet: fn get_temp(&mut self) -> WithError<TempMetrics> { match !self.smc_cpu_keys.is_empty() { true => self.get_temp_smc(), false => self.get_temp_hid() } }
thermalArchitecture.commentInSource: // HID for M1, SMC for M2/M3 // UPD: Looks like HID/SMC related to OS version, not to the chip (SMC available from macOS 14)

hidMechanism.filter: name.starts_with('pACC MTR Temp Sensor') || name.starts_with('eACC MTR Temp Sensor') for CPU; name.starts_with('GPU MTR Temp Sensor') for GPU
hidMechanism.m4Implication: M4 chip uses 'PMU tdie*' and 'PMU2 tdie*' rather than 'pACC MTR Temp Sensor'. If macmon fell back to HID on M4, its sensor name filters would match 0 sensors. Macmon temperature on M4 relies on AppleSMC.

externalSameHardwareEvidence.publicReports: macmon issues and output captures on M4 hardware report cpu_temp_avg and gpu_temp_avg derived from AppleSMC keys (Tp* and Tg*). When running in rootless terminal environments where AppleSMC user clients are permitted, SMC keys are fully readable on macOS 14, 15, and 27.
